roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator & Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:

If you are a proactive and experienced Registered Nurse passionate about education and patient safety, we encourage you to apply and become a key part of our compassionate team.

description:

description:

description:

As a Physical Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing patients' physical conditions, developing individualized treatment plans, and implementing therapeutic exercises and modalities to restore function, reduce pain, and prevent disability. You will work collaboratively with other healthcare professionals to ensure comprehensive and coordinated care, helping patients achieve their maximum potential for independence and mobility.

This role offers a competitive hourly rate for your expertise. If you are passionate about rehabilitation and looking for a flexible opportunity to apply your skills, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Graduate of an accredited Physical Therapy program
Experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting preferred
Ability to work independently and manage a caseload effectively
Strong communication and interpersonal skills
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate for Physical Therapists is between $39.00 - $40.00, based on experience.

description:

description:

description:

description:

description:
Join a premier healthcare services provider as a Full-time Remote Radiologist. We are seeking a highly skilled and New York State licensed Radiologist with expertise in Musculoskeletal (MSK) imaging. This role is designed for a radiologist who thrives in a remote setting and is comfortable with a compensation structure that is heavily weighted towards bonuses. You will be responsible for reading MRI, CT, and X-Ray scans, with a specific emphasis on MSK cases. The ability to work weekends is a key requirement for this position.

We are looking for a dedicated professional to contribute to our team, providing critical diagnostic insights for our patients. If you are a New York-licensed Radiologist with a strong background in Workers Compensation and No-Fault cases, and are looking for a flexible, remote role with significant earning potential, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Current New York State Radiologist license
Proficiency in reading Musculoskeletal (MSK) images
Demonstrated experience with Workers Compensation and No-Fault (NF) cases
Ability to work weekends
NY WCB (Workers' Compensation Board) number preferred
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation is structured with a strong emphasis on bonuses, including per-study rates of $50 per MRI, $30 per CT, and $10 per X-Ray. Experience in Workers Compensation and No-Fault/Lien cases is essential. Overall compensation will be based on experience and productivity.
